messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Vampire Survivors-style game where the player controls the enemy horde.

## Requirements
- Responsive desktop and mobile play.
- Player steers a horde, summons ghouls, and uses a blood-frenzy ability.
- Win by defeating the surviving hunter; survive until dawn for a loss state.
- Include start, active gameplay, pause, and result screens.

## Decisions
- Used a single self-contained `index.html` with Canvas rendering and no external game framework.
- Added desktop WASD/arrow controls, Q summon, Space frenzy, mouse drag, and on-screen mobile controls.
- Assumed a 90-second objective and 35-ghoul horde cap.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the graveyard arena, hunter AI, horde movement, combat, essence economy, win/loss states, pause/restart flow, HUD, and mobile controls.
- Added atmospheric ground, tombstones, trees, mist, particles, projectiles, and responsive layouts.
- Verified JavaScript syntax.
- Tested the start and gameplay views at desktop and mobile viewport sizes.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Resume visual polish or gameplay balance by editing `index.html`.
2. Re-run the local server and browser checks after substantive changes.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete game implementation.
- `[screenshots/game.jpg]`: Latest desktop gameplay screenshot.
- `[screenshots/menu.jpg]`: Desktop start-screen screenshot.
- `[screenshots/mobile.jpg]`: Latest mobile viewport screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is available at `http://localhost:3002/` when the local server is running.
- Current implementation uses a 1800×1200 world that scrolls with the horde.
- Essence starts at 26, summoning costs 12, and enemy kills add 3 essence.
- Hunter attacks return some essence to the player.
